//: Covers the repo-root TypeScript that belongs to no workspace: the offline gate and its
setup file (test/), the generator scripts (tools/) and vitest.config.ts. Before this
existed, `npm run typecheck` delegated only to the two packages, so none of these files
was type-checked by anything at all — the offline gate in particular did not compile.
Same compilerOptions as packages/*/tsconfig.json, deliberately: strict,
noUncheckedIndexedAccess and verbatimModuleSyntax are what much of this codebase's
defensive guarding exists to satisfy, and root-level test infrastructure is not exempt.
